params.message:
Linking a team account ends every way in from before

Registering on gentells.com asks for no proof of the address. A team member who signs in
with the Observatory password is linked to the account that exists on their address, and
whoever made it kept its password, sessions, keys and linked providers. These end at the
moment of linking now. Signing in again later leaves the account as it is.

A linked provider no longer counts as proof for the team's tools on /mcp: linking one does
not ask for a confirmed address. Blocking an account also ends the refresh tokens of its keys.

Portal: Een teamaccount op gentells.com heeft na het koppelen alleen nog de eigen toegang.
